parole.significato: vat, wide-bellied bowl, trough – such as for example a kneading trough, or a pottery coffin for burial until the IIIʳᵈ…
parole.testo: Generally believed to be of Coptic origin, however the exact word is omitted. One option is *ⲙⲁϫⲱⲣ (*majōr) from ⲙⲁ- (ma-, “place”) + ϫⲱⲣ (jōr, “to scatter”), another ⲙⲁⲕⲣⲟ (makro, “trough, mortar”) to which colloquial Egyptian Arabic could have applied the tool-pattern as in كَالُون (kālūn). Howeve
